How to respond to negative Google reviews (with 10 ready-made templates)
t.A boa notícia: uma resposta madura a uma: The good news: one mature reply to a harsh review wins more customers than ten replies to compliments. The bad news: most owners reply in the heat of the moment and turn one lost star into permanent damage. Let's take the right path.

t.A estrutura que funciona pra (quase) qua: The structure that works for (almost) any complaint

h.Uma crítica de 1 estrela aparece e o ins: A 1-star review shows up and your instinct is to defend yourself right away. Hold on. The way you reply is read by hundreds of future customers — and it's worth far more than the rating itself. This guide shows you the step-by-step, gives you 10 template replies by situation and explains what to do when the review is fake.
h.Quem lê uma avaliação negativa quase nun: The person reading a negative review is almost never the one who wrote it. It's the next customer, torn between you and a competitor, scrolling down to see how the owner reacts when someone complains. That's why replying well to criticism isn't about convincing the upset customer — it's about showing everyone watching that this is a business that listens.
h.Espere esfriar, mas não demore. Responda: Let it cool down, but don't take long. Reply once the irritation has passed — but within 24 to 48 hours. A complaint left unanswered for weeks sends the message that nobody is paying attention.
h.Responda em público, resolva em particul: Reply in public, resolve in private. The public reply is short and cordial; the problem itself you take to a private channel (phone, WhatsApp, email).
h.Nunca discuta os fatos linha a linha. \": Never argue the facts line by line. "That didn't happen" turns into a fight. Nobody wins an argument in front of an audience.
h.Uma resposta, não três. Respondeu, ofere: One reply, not three. You replied, offered a solution, done. Going back and forth turns into a soap opera and sinks you.
h.Lembre do público invisível: escreva cad: Remember the invisible audience: write every reply imagining the next customer will read it out loud. If it sounds defensive, sarcastic or cold, rewrite it.
h.Agradecimento + nome. \"Oi, [Nome], obri: Thanks + name. "Hi, [Name], thanks for letting us know." Acknowledging it already lowers the temperature.
h.Reconhecimento sem se rebaixar. Valide o: Acknowledgment without groveling. Validate the feeling ("I understand the frustration of waiting longer than agreed") without necessarily admitting fault you didn't have.
h.O que você vai fazer. A correção concret: What you're going to do. The concrete fix or the invitation to resolve it privately.
h.Porta aberta. Um canal direto pra contin: An open door. A direct channel to continue the conversation.
h.Com esse esqueleto na cabeça, vão os 10: With that skeleton in mind, here are the 10 templates. Adapt the tone to your business — a car repair shop talks differently from a salon — and replace the brackets with real details. A reply that looks copied from a manual is almost as bad as not replying.
h.Repare no tom: você registra publicament: Notice the tone: you publicly record your doubt about its authenticity without accusing anyone. This protects your reputation and lays the groundwork in case you need to request removal — which we cover further down.
h.Importante: nunca peça, na resposta públ: Important: never ask the person, in your public reply, to change their rating. It comes across as pressure, and Google discourages this kind of manipulation. Solve it well — many people update their review on their own when they're treated well.
h.❌ \"Isso é mentira / você está inventand: ❌ "That's a lie / you're making it up." Even when it is, accusing someone in front of everyone does more damage than the complaint.
h.❌ Ironia ou sarcasmo. \"Que pena que a g: ❌ Irony or sarcasm. "Too bad we couldn't read your mind" is funny in the WhatsApp group and terrible on your profile.
h.❌ Expor dados do cliente. Citar valor pa: ❌ Exposing customer data. Mentioning the amount paid, what they ordered or personal details to "prove your point" is unethical and may violate the LGPD (Brazil's General Data Protection Law).
h.❌ Copiar e colar a mesma resposta em tud: ❌ Copying and pasting the same reply everywhere. Five complaints with the same robotic sentence scream indifference.
h.❌ Ameaçar processar ou revidar. Vira not: ❌ Threatening to sue or retaliate. It becomes news — the wrong kind.
h.❌ Sumir. Não responder é responder: diz: ❌ Disappearing. Not replying is a reply: it says nobody cares.
h.Responder é a regra pra crítica legítima: Replying is the rule for legitimate criticism. But there's a different case: the review that breaks Google's policies and shouldn't be there at all. Google removes (not always, but it does) reviews that fall into situations like:
h.Conteúdo falso ou de quem nunca foi clie: Fake content or reviews from someone who was never a customer (spam, a competitor's review, a coordinated attack).
h.Ofensa, discurso de ódio, palavrão pesad: Insults, hate speech, heavy profanity or sexual content.
h.Conflito de interesse — avaliação de ex-: Conflict of interest — a review from a former employee or a competitor.
h.Assunto que não tem relação com a experi: Topics that have nothing to do with the experience at your business (political complaints, advertising, links).
h.No seu perfil do Google (Google Maps ou: On your Google profile (Google Maps or Search), open the review, tap the three dots and choose "Report review". Select the reason that applies.
h.Se não resolver, use a ferramenta de ger: If that doesn't work, use Google Business Profile's review management tool to track the status of your report.
h.Ainda sem sucesso? Acione o suporte do G: Still no luck? Contact Google Business Profile support (chat or form) and explain objectively why the review violates the policy — with screenshots and dates.
h.Enquanto o Google analisa, responda mesm: While Google reviews it, reply anyway. A polite reply (template 7) shows readers that the complaint doesn't match reality — and the report can take days or not be accepted at all. Don't leave the review "out there" without context.
h.E um alerta honesto: denúncia não é botã: And an honest warning: reporting is not a delete button for criticism you didn't like. Google only removes what actually breaks the rules. A genuine negative review, however harsh, won't come down — and it shouldn't. The way out is to reply well and, over the medium term, dilute it with real reviews from happy customers.
h.A tentação, nessa hora, é comprar avalia: The temptation at this point is to buy reviews to "cover up" the bad ones. Don't. Google detects fake review patterns with increasingly sharp systems, and the penalty ranges from mass removal of reviews to suspension of the profile — in other words, you trade two lost stars for losing the whole profile. The same goes for tools that do review gating (filtering who reviews so only happy customers are sent to Google): it's against the policies and puts your profile at risk.
h.O caminho sustentável é o chato e o que: The sustainable path is the boring one, and the one that works: ask every happy customer for a review, consistently, cutting friction as much as possible. That's why NFC stands and QR Codes on the counter have become standard in local businesses that grow their reputation — the customer already has their phone in hand, taps it and leaves a review in 30 seconds, no "I'll do it later".
